name: contacts-conference-sfhh
description: Temporal face-to-face proximity contacts. Nodes represent individuals. Original data are pairwise contacts; hyperedges are constructed by promoting cliques of contacts into higher-order group interactions.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.id: (INT) Unique identifier for the conference attendee (e.g., 1269).

edges_metadata.original_time: (INT) Original timestamp of the contact event (seconds from start) (e.g., 32520).
edges_metadata.time: (INT) Normalized timestamp of the contact event (seconds from start) (e.g., 0).
